description: Use this when the user wants to print address labels, mailing labels, return address labels, shipping labels, name badges or name tags, place cards, or file folder labels from a list or a spreadsheet ("avery 5160 template", "print address labels from excel", "mailing labels from excel", "make return address labels", "print christmas card addresses on labels", "start printing at label 7 on a used sheet"). Builds a vector PDF on US Letter that lines up with the chosen label sheet (5160/8160 30 per sheet, 5161, 5162, 5163, 5164, 5168, 5126, 5167, 5195, 5366, 5395, 5390, 22805, 5302 place cards), with USPS address lines, font shrink-to-fit, a start position for partly used sheets, copies per label, return-address fill mode, an optional alignment test page and outlines. Accepts typed labels or an uploaded CSV/XLSX file. Returns a preview, the PDF and a cleaned CSV. Does not buy postage, print USPS shipping labels with postage, make barcodes, or design nutrition labels.

align.description: Text alignment: left (default for addresses) or center (default for badges, place cards and square labels).

alignment_test.description: Add a test page first with each label outlined and numbered, to print on plain paper and hold against a label sheet. With no list, the PDF is only the test page. Default false.

bold_first_line.description: Print the first line (the name) in bold. Default false for addresses; badges and place cards print the name in bold.

columns.description: Optional column mapping when the headings are unusual: heading text or column letter per field, e.g. {"name":"Guest","address1":"Mailing Street","zip":"F"}.

address1.description: Column heading or letter for address1, e.g. "address1".

address2.description: Column heading or letter for address2, e.g. "address2".

city.description: Column heading or letter for city, e.g. "city".

company.description: Column heading or letter for company, e.g. "company".

country.description: Column heading or letter for country, e.g. "country".

first_name.description: Column heading or letter for first_name, e.g. "first name".

last_name.description: Column heading or letter for last_name, e.g. "last name".

name.description: Column heading or letter for name, e.g. "Full Name" or "A".

state.description: Column heading or letter for state, e.g. "state".

table.description: Column heading or letter for table, e.g. "table".

title.description: Column heading or letter for title, e.g. "title".

zip.description: Column heading or letter for zip, e.g. "Postal Code" or "F".

copies.description: Copies of each label, e.g. 2. Default 1.

file.description: Optional uploaded mailing list: a CSV, TSV or Excel .xlsx file with one row per label, e.g. contacts.csv or Christmas list.xlsx. Name, address, city, state and ZIP columns are detected from the headings (Google Contacts, Outlook, Etsy and Shopify exports work).

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

fill_sheet.description: Repeat a single label (a return address) to fill the whole sheet. Default true for kind return_address with one label.

has_header.description: Whether the file's first row is column headings. Default: detected (headings like Name, Address, ZIP or a first row without numbers).

include_country.description: Also print USA on US addresses that have a country. Default false (non-US countries always print).

kind.description: What the labels are for: address (mailing labels, default), return_address, shipping, name_badge, place_card, file_folder or general text. Sets the default sheet and text style.

labels.description:
The typed or pasted list, one item per label. Either address objects, e.g. [{"name":"Jane Smith","address1":"123 Main St","address2":"Apt 4B","city":"Springfield","state":"IL","zip":"62704"}], or plain text labels with lines separated by 
, e.g. ["Jane Smith
123 Main St
Springfield, IL 62704"]. For name badges use {"name":"Ana Lopez","title":"Engineer","company":"Acme"}.

address1.description: Street address, e.g. 123 Main St. A whole one-line address like "123 Main St, Springfield, IL 62704" is split automatically.

address2.description: Apartment, suite or unit, e.g. Apt 4B.

company.description: Company or organization line, e.g. Acme Corp.

country.description: Country for international mail, e.g. Canada. Leave empty for US addresses.

name.description: Recipient or person name, e.g. Jane Smith or The Garcia Family.

state.description: State, e.g. IL or Illinois (converted to the USPS two-letter code).

table.description: Table number or name for place cards, e.g. 4.

title.description: Job title or second line for badges, e.g. Product Manager.

max_font_size.description: Largest font size in points; long lines shrink below it to fit, e.g. 12. Default depends on the sheet (11 for 5160).

outline.description: Draw a thin grey outline around each label (for printing on plain paper). Default false.

remove_duplicates.description: Print identical labels only once. Default false (duplicates are counted and reported).

sheet.description: Excel sheet name to read, e.g. Guests. Default: the first sheet with data.

sheets.description: With fill_sheet: how many full sheets to fill, e.g. 3. Default 1.

sort.description: Order of the labels: none (list order, default), zip, name or last_name.

start_at.description: Label position to start on for a partly used sheet, counted left to right then top to bottom, e.g. 7 skips the first 6 labels. Default 1.

template.description: Label sheet product number, e.g. 5160 (also 8160, 18160, 5260...), 5163 or 5395. Supported layouts: 5160, 5161, 5162, 5163, 5164, 5168, 5126, 5167, 5195, 5366, 5395, 5390, 22805, 5302. Default by kind: address 5160, return_address 5167, shipping 5163, name_badge 5395, place_card 5302, file_folder 5366.

uppercase.description: USPS style: all capitals without periods or commas (e.g. SPRINGFIELD IL 62704). Default false.

name: generate_label_sheet
title: Generate label sheet PDF
